details.description: Llama 3 8B Instruct is Meta's instruction-tuned, 8-billion-parameter chat model in the Llama 3 family, released April 18, 2024 alongside the base checkpoint. Meta fine-tuned it from the pretrained model using supervised fine-tuning, rejection sampling, PPO and DPO, and it shares the base model's 8,192-token context window and March 2023 knowledge cutoff. Fireworks AI serves this target as the '-hf' build, which Fireworks describes as the original FP16 version whose outputs should match the official Hugging Face implementation, rather than a quantized variant.
advantages: Scores 68.4 on MMLU, 62.2% on HumanEval and 79.6% on GSM-8K as the instruction-tuned 8B model, per Meta's official Llama 3 model card.
Fireworks AI states this FP16 build's results should be consistent with the official Hugging Face implementation, unlike quantized variants.
disadvantages: Context window is limited to 8,192 tokens, far short of the 128,000-token window Meta introduced with the later Llama 3.1 family.
Meta's model card states intended use is commercial and research use in English; using it in other languages requires developers to fine-tune and safety-test it themselves.
